Phase 1 (chart builder + saved views) hits its design-partner beta on **Wednesday Dec 9**, open to just 5 customers: Orbitly, Zest Grocers and three accounts from the October trial cohort [3][11]. Phase 1 was to be feature-complete behind the `dash_v2` flag by Dec 4 [2].

Everyone else waits: no access before general availability, targeted at late January but not committed, with a waitlist opening in January [3][11]. Priya explicitly asked that no one promise access to customers outside the beta list [11].
